# FroggyAds

> FroggyAds is a self-serve DSP and global ad network for advertisers, media buyers, agencies and performance marketers. One account gives you DSP-level control over network-scale supply, with SmartCPC optimization, Adscore traffic filtering and source-level whitelist and blacklist control. Signup: https://premium.froggyads.com/#/signup

## Who FroggyAds is for
Advertisers, professional media buyers, affiliate marketers, agencies and publishers who want worldwide traffic with granular control, clean supply and transparent, bid-based pricing from a $50 minimum deposit.

## Key facts
- 20B+ daily impressions
- 750+ SSP integrations
- 15,000+ advertisers and professional media buyers
- 300+ verticals
- $50 minimum deposit (qualifying deposits earn bonus ad credits, 6% up to 28%)
- SmartCPC optimization, Adscore traffic filtering, source-level controls, worldwide access
- 8 ad formats: push, native, Telegram Ads, display, pop, interstitial, video, audience targeting

## DSP platform
- [Self-Serve DSP](https://froggyads.com/self-serve-dsp/): Programmatic buying, bidding, reporting and source controls from one dashboard.
- [Programmatic Advertising Platform](https://froggyads.com/programmatic-advertising-platform/): How FroggyAds connects advertisers to global supply.
- [Publisher Supply Network](https://froggyads.com/publisher-supply-network/): 750+ SSP integrations with source-level control.
- [Ad Network API](https://froggyads.com/ad-network-api/): OpenRTB, S2S postbacks and reporting integration.

## Ad formats
- [Push Ads](https://froggyads.com/push-ads/), [Native Ads](https://froggyads.com/native-ads/), [Telegram Ads](https://froggyads.com/telegram-ads/), [Display Ads](https://froggyads.com/display-ads/), [Pop Ads](https://froggyads.com/pop-ads/), [Interstitial Ads](https://froggyads.com/interstitial-ads/), [Video Ads](https://froggyads.com/video-ads/), [Audience Targeting](https://froggyads.com/audience-targeting/).

## Traffic and GEO
- [Worldwide Ad Network](https://froggyads.com/worldwide-ad-network/), [Tier 1 Traffic](https://froggyads.com/tier-1-traffic/), [US Traffic](https://froggyads.com/us-traffic/), [Europe Traffic](https://froggyads.com/europe-traffic/), [Mobile Traffic](https://froggyads.com/mobile-traffic/), [Desktop Traffic](https://froggyads.com/desktop-traffic/), [High-Volume Traffic](https://froggyads.com/high-volume-traffic/), [Low-Cost Traffic](https://froggyads.com/low-cost-traffic/).

## Targeting and optimization
- [SmartCPC](https://froggyads.com/smartcpc/): Automatic bid optimization toward your target CPA.
- [GEO Targeting](https://froggyads.com/geo-targeting/), [Source ID Targeting](https://froggyads.com/source-id-targeting/), [Whitelist Targeting](https://froggyads.com/whitelist-targeting/), [Frequency Capping](https://froggyads.com/frequency-capping/), [Retargeting Traffic](https://froggyads.com/retargeting-traffic/).
- [Interest Targeting](https://froggyads.com/interest-targeting/), [Lookalike Audiences](https://froggyads.com/lookalike-audiences/), [IP Targeting](https://froggyads.com/ip-targeting/), [Language Targeting](https://froggyads.com/language-targeting/), [Cross-Device Targeting](https://froggyads.com/cross-device-targeting/), [Dynamic Retargeting](https://froggyads.com/dynamic-retargeting/).

- [Conversion Tracking](https://froggyads.com/conversion-tracking/): Pixel and postback setup, source-level attribution.
- [Postback Tracking](https://froggyads.com/postback-tracking/): Server-to-server conversion tracking setup and troubleshooting.
- [Tracking Macros](https://froggyads.com/tracking-macros/): Reference for FroggyAds tracking macros and safe URL examples.

## Traffic quality and brand safety
- [Adscore Traffic Quality](https://froggyads.com/adscore-traffic-quality/): Bot and invalid-traffic filtering on every impression.
- [Ad Fraud Protection](https://froggyads.com/ad-fraud-protection/), [Brand Safety](https://froggyads.com/brand-safety/).
